plan: Since this is a single-round auction, and my value is $13, I want to bid slightly above what I expect the second-highest bid to be, while minimizing risk. I'll consider the worst-case scenario: if I bid $13.1 and another bidder bids $13.2, I lose and pay nothing. If I bid higher, say $13.5, I risk paying more. I will bid $12.6 to try and win at a reasonable price.

This is round 1, so there's no history to learn from. My value is $9. I need to bid high enough to win against likely low bids, but not so high that I overpay significantly. The worst case is bidding just above the other bidders, but still paying close to $9. A bid of $9.50 seems reasonable, aiming to win against bids likely below $9, while limiting potential loss if others bid close to my value.
